_comment: Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json). Cursor splits `command` on spaces, so /Applications/Warp Command Runner.app/... fails with spawn /Applications/Warp ENOENT. That is a Cursor host bug — do not rename the .app. Warp and Claude Desktop should keep the official /Applications path. For Cursor: run helper/install-cursor-wrapper.sh, then set command to ~/.local/bin/warp-command-runner (expand YOURUSER). Cursor already has a terminal; register this only if you want commands typed into Warp.
